# Tutorials on Apify API

**A collection of various tutorials explaining how to interact with the Apify platform programmatically using its API.**

***

This section explains how you can run [Apify Actors](https://docs.apify.com/actors.md) using Apify's [API](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2.md), retrieve their results, and integrate them into your own product and workflows. You can do this using a raw HTTP client, or you can benefit from using one of our API clients for:

* [JavaScript](https://docs.apify.com/api/client/js)
* [Python](https://docs.apify.com/api/client/python)
